title: Sara Duterte owns 22 firearms, says PNP official
summary: PNP Firearms and Explosives Office chief Joericson Sangalang, whom the prosecution presented as a witness in Duterte’s impeachment trial, said the agency’s records show that Duterte owns 14 pistols,…

blocks.text: PNP Firearms and Explosives Office chief Joericson Sangalang, whom the prosecution presented as a witness in Duterte’s impeachment trial, said the agency’s records show that Duterte owns 14 pistols, two revolvers, five rifles including three Class-A light weapons, and one shotgun.

why: headline only by design — this outlet blocks article pages
